findings.body: readPrior counts isReplayable into foldedPending; nextReplayable only iterates s.rings. Accepted follow-up. findings.title: Decision regex runs on unbounded assistant answer text.
findings.body: decisionsOf(answer) → answer.matchAll(DECISION_LINE) with no slice/pre-bound. Accepted follow-up. [plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge/hooks/register.tsx] ADJUDICATION: Coordinator: STILL_PRESENT, accepted follow-up; severity LOW; no ReDoS. Unchanged and out of scope. `decisionsOf` runs `matchAll` on the whole answer with no pre-bound; the regex is line-anchored without nested quantifiers, so cost is linear per finished turn. Accepted for the predecessor head on 2026-10-24; not re-accepted for this head.

findings.title: Observing tool.call intentionally does not await observeTool before returning, relying on host microtask ordering so turn digests stay complete.
findings.body: on('tool.call') awaits next then void observeTool(...).captureTurn snapshots s.files/s.todosDone synchronously when later invoked. Tests pass under mock settle; production interleaving UNKNOWN. Design trades await-delay for hook non-blocking. [plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge/hooks/register.tsx] ADJUDICATION: Coordinator: CONFIRMED as a design note; severity INFO; no defect shown. `register.tsx:1273-1281`: the `tool.call` hook awaits `next(e)`, then starts `observeTool` with `void` and returns the result unchanged, so the host's tool call is never delayed. A turn's `turn.complete` follows at least one model round-trip, and `observeTool` only awaits a cached root lookup and an append, so the digest is complete in practice; the tests settle the mock clock. Production interleaving is UNKNOWN, which is the auditor's own wording. New finding, not a regression: the pattern was in the first audited head and the first audit did not raise it.
